section.title: Light and minimal stemmers
section.para: The package opennlp.tools.stemmer.light provides light and minimal stemmers based on algorithms in Apache Lucene's analysis-common module. Light stemmers remove a modest set of endings; minimal stemmers remove fewer. Instances are immutable, safe for concurrent use, and implement StemmerFactory. Input must use lowercase NFC. The stemmers do not apply case folding or Unicode normalization.

Languages with a light stemmer include German, Spanish, Finnish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, and Swedish. Minimal stemmers are available for German, English, Spanish, French, Norwegian, and Swedish. Norwegian variants are selected through NorwegianVariety. LightStemmerUsageExampleTest checks these results.
GermanLightStemmer light = new GermanLightStemmer(); light.stem("häusern"); // "haus"
new SpanishMinimalStemmer().stem("jerseis"); // "jersey"
NorwegianLightStemmer bokmaal = new NorwegianLightStemmer(NorwegianVariety.BOKMAAL); bokmaal.stem("hemmeligheten"); // "hemmelig"
